text:
deploybot: Starting canary rollout for release v3.2.1 -> canary-12 (10% traffic) in change window 2026-03-21T22:00Z - 23:00Z. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/deploys#canary-unwind :rocket:
elaine: Quick question — where's the concise backout checklist? need the unpin + revert steps in one place.
raj: put the short checklist into the runbook section above, but TL;DR: unpin canary -> revert tag -> escalate.
raj: commands:```bash
# unpin canary traffic
redwoodctl routes update --route chat-model --set-weight canary-12=0 stable=100
# tag rollback in registry
redwoodctl model tag set chat-model:v3.2.0 live
```
tim-coordinator: note the change window ends in 40m. if metrics look flaky we stop the rollout and then follow the runbook. please ack owners.
oncall: Thresholds to trigger stop/rollback: 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 600ms for 10m OR error-rate regression on key prompts > 3x baseline.
elaine: ack. who has final rollback authority if team lead unavailable?
sre_lead: Oncall has primary authority for immediate safety stop. Release owner (tim-coordinator) and eng-release lead must sign off on permanent rollback. If oncall stops rollout, they should run the unpin (raj's snippet) and post the incident link.
elaine: copying the incident runbook link here: https://redwood-internal/incidents/deploy-unwind-2026. Use that for post-mortem checklist.
deploybot: Canary traffic adjusted -> canary-12=0 stable=100 (executed by oncall at 3772001256). Link: https://deploys.redwood/status/3772001234
oncall: executed unpin and started revert to v3.2.0. posting logs in #incidents. :white_check_mark:
sre_lead: after revert, please follow post-rollback verification steps in runbook: smoke tests, sampling logs, UX spot-check. If all green, we can coordinate a safe re-roll with the release owner.
elaine: thanks all. I'll draft a short release-note blurb and the runbook snippet for docs team. :thumbsup:
